plans.description: The signature Esper enchantress engine: play enchantments to draw cards (Mesa Enchantress, Ondu Spiritdancer, Starfield Mystic discounts), snowball value, and control the board. Aminatou's miracle −{4} makes every enchantment in hand a potential cheap blowout, and surveil 2 each upkeep feeds both the enchantment count and the miracle trigger.
plans.win: Overwhelming board: Sigil of the Empty Throne turns every enchantment into a 4/4 Angel, Extravagant Replication doubles your best permanent each upkeep, One with the Multiverse plays from the top of your library. Close with Redress Fate recursion or a giant Entreat the Angels (miracle for {W}{W}{W}{W}).

plans.description: Aminatou's second identity: topdeck manipulation + miracle. Surveil 2 at upkeep, then cantrips (Brainstorm, Ponder, Portent, Telling Time), Halimar Depths and Brainstone set up the top of the library so your miracle draws hit. One with the Multiverse turns the top of the library into an extra hand.
plans.win: Aminatou's Augury casts your whole top 8 for free; Terminus becomes a one-mana wipe via miracle; Entreat the Angels and Shark Typhoon finish from the top. Infinite turns via Timestream Navigator + Extravagant Replication (see combos).

combos.title: Timestream Navigator + Extravagant Replication
combos.description:
During your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
During your next upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of a Timestream Navigator token that did not enter the battlefield this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn.
Repeat from 2.

combos.title: Wanderwine Prophets + Extravagant Replication
combos.description:

plans.description: Esper control with enchantment-based answers: Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Utter End, Cast Out, Return to Dust, Arcane Denial and counterspells keep the table in check while the enchantress engine refills your hand. Doomwake Giant is a recurring wipe via constellation.
plans.win: Out-value and out-last: Terminus/Time Wipe reset the board, then win with the enchantress card advantage — Angel tokens, Dream Eater beats, or a copied engine via Mirrormade/Extravagant Replication. Sharuum + Mirrormade loops are infinite ETB (see combos).

verdict.text: The Miracle Worker list is built AROUND Aminatou's enchantment-miracles ability: 15 enchantments + 8 enchantress-style payoffs (Mesa Enchantress, Ondu Spiritdancer, Sigil of the Empty Throne, One with the Multiverse, Sphere of Safety...). 10 of the deck's cards sit in the EDHREC High Synergy pool of BOTH the Enchantress (2,872 decks) and Topdeck (2,108) plans — the two dominant archetypes. Control (282) and Pillow Fort (154) are supported by the same cards (Sphere of Safety, Shark Typhoon, removal suite). Tokens/Combo are incidental: Sigil of the Empty Throne and Extravagant Replication make tokens but the list has no token payoffs beyond them. Verdict: the list is a classic Enchantress/Miracles control deck — Enchantress and Topdeck are co-favored, with Pillow Fort as the natural secondary plan.

structure.summary: The list is structurally sound on the fundamentals: 36 lands and 10 ramp (rocks mostly CMC ≤ 2) match the ideal 100-card build, and interaction (12) plus wipes (2) are in range. The weaknesses are the classic precon issues: average CMC 4.03 is well above the ≤ 3.2 golden rule (the top end is loaded with 5-8 mana enchantments: One with the Multiverse, Extravagant Replication, Aminatou's Augury), synergies/wincons fill only 25 of the ideal 30-35 slots (several 5-6 mana creatures are value engines rather than finishers), and the deck has just 1 flex slot. Upgrade path: cut the weakest 5-6 mana engine for 2-3 more 2-3 CMC rocks/draw (Thirst for Meaning-class cantrips) and 2-3 dedicated finishers to pull the curve under 3.5 while keeping the enchantress core.
